text.content: For 4–5 players: David Smith (@UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David Smith}) and 3 or 4 new characters. Bear (@UUID[JournalEntry.sP1Adp7t6FvaF4zw]{Tom “Bear” Whitman}) remains an NPC. These are concepts with background; the players build the mechanical sheet using the core rulebook. Sections marked “Secret” are for the Storyteller only.

pages.name: Which Clans I Recommend and Why

text.content:
David is already the group's Brujah, and the city has three more Brujah NPCs (Rosa, Krell, and O'Connor), so it's best not to repeat the clan. Each clan below opens a different front of the plot, so everyone gets their moment.

Clan Plot front Why it works
Ventrue Politics and infiltration of Halloway's circle Puts the coterie inside the antagonist's house. Creates the strongest loyalty dilemma in the adventure.
Nosferatu Information, the underground, and the surveillance network Seattle is the city of data, and a Nosferatu hacker is the natural counterweight to Gale Sentinel and FIRSTLIGHT.
Toreador The Prince's court and Helen's circle With a Toreador Prince, this character lives at the center of the coup. They can also be tied to the podcast.
Gangrel The Sheriff's pack, tracking, and combat Connects to Montgomery and to David's past. Gives weight to the scene where the Sheriff hesitates (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}).
Tremere (alternative) Forensics, Blood Sorcery, and the crack in the Masquerade The fifth option if there are five players, or a substitute for any of the above.

Recommendation for 4 players: David, Ventrue, Nosferatu, and Toreador. For 5: add the Gangrel. The Tremere stays in reserve.

Every character appears in the Ward File. When the drive is stolen, they're all exposed at once, and Sheriff Montgomery wastes no time telling them: “You're all on the same drive. Either you get it back together or you fall together.” It's a Commando coterie, with its domain on the Harbor Island docks, around David's hangar, and each player receives their folder (@UUID[JournalEntry.vtenvgNlXVPd99Rc]{“Your Folder in the File”}).

The full coterie page (concept, alternatives, members and agendas, customs, type, domain, and shared Backgrounds, with what doc 02 says and what doc 08 settles) is at @UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.kiaygGF4KgylB6fb]{The Archived}.

pages.name: Adjusting the Outline for a Coterie

text.content:
• @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE}: Helen calls SAFE; David summons the coterie. Nadia, if present, arrives on her own: she knows the apartment.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.xWx5IoPih8fX83b1]{A1-E03 · The Sheriff Asks}: becomes the coterie's formation scene. Montgomery gathers them all at his farm.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}: Krell goes after the most exposed Touchstone of any character (Helen, Bear, Maja, Theo, Ingrid…), not just Bear or Helen.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}: if Hal is in play, the scene turns on him: Montgomery demands his reports in front of everyone.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.snrsN5RkdAklRIDn]{A4-E01 · Primogen Council}: if Celeste is in play, Halloway offers her up as the traitor. If Nadia is in play, Whitmore uses her as his voice before the Council.
  • Scaling the tests: the outline's Difficulties stay the same; scale the enemies by adding one minor NPC for each player beyond two.
